name: MorningRunPipeline
description: The daily morning run (workflow MorningRun, Sun–Thu 07:30 Israel): writes the morning briefing (WriteBriefing → AgentBriefings), then the daily customer summaries (CustomerSummaryRun: Iris writes a short summary and one suggested action per customer with an open balance, task or promise → CustomerDailySummaries). Promise checks moved to the 06:00 task scan (TaskScanPipeline) on 01.11. Nothing is sent or written to Priority.
